items.text: Fixed frog animation glitches and corrected movement speed; added water‑drinking need for livestock animals, allowing them to drink from containers or natural water sources.
Added a work‑in‑progress “interested” state for frogs, causing them to seek shallow water and start croaking.

Improved vehicle pooling handling with a restoreHierarchy flag, refined suspension, steering, grip and engine rev behavior (including removal of broken burnout launch and visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake), and added aim sway that scales with movement speed when using held weapons from the helicopter passenger seat.

Prevented building volumes from being baked into the navmesh, fixed navmesh generation failures, and optimized path‑following logic, doubling NPC path‑following performance and reducing per‑frame calculations for steering agents.
Fixed store prop drawer rendering by adding a fallback image path and added DynamicResourceRef support to the UI Store takeover system, improving dynamic bundle handling.

Enabled hotbar swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC while preserving admin checks, repaired the repair bench, corrected arrow icon assets, fixed cached skin ID handling for skin crafting, and implemented ammo model types to visually indicate remaining rounds for applicable revolvers.
Added proximity fuses to SAM missiles against drones, increased missile lead speed, enabled destruction of drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and introduced a tunable drone detonation distance.
Doubled duration for several pies and raised hunters pie bleed reduction to 90%.

Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, boat planner tech tree cost lowered, longsword swing radius and delay adjusted for faster, more accurate attacks, swamp tree wood harvest amount increased from 300 to 1000, and tax collectors now have a tiered upkeep modifier based on player count.
Random skin crafting now includes the default skin in the random pool.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Animals
- Fixed frog animation glitches and corrected movement speed; added water‑drinking need for livestock animals, allowing them to drink from containers or natural water sources.
- Added a work‑in‑progress “interested” state for frogs, causing them to seek shallow water and start croaking.

### Vehicles
- Improved vehicle pooling handling with a restoreHierarchy flag, refined suspension, steering, grip and engine rev behavior (including removal of broken burnout launch and visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake), and added aim sway that scales with movement speed when using held weapons from the helicopter passenger seat.

### NPC & AI
- Prevented building volumes from being baked into the navmesh, fixed navmesh generation failures, and optimized path‑following logic, doubling NPC path‑following performance and reducing per‑frame calculations for steering agents.

### UI & Inventory
- Fixed store prop drawer rendering by adding a fallback image path and added DynamicResourceRef support to the UI Store takeover system, improving dynamic bundle handling.
- Enabled hotbar swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC while preserving admin checks, repaired the repair bench, corrected arrow icon assets, fixed cached skin ID handling for skin crafting, and implemented ammo model types to visually indicate remaining rounds for applicable revolvers.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added proximity fuses to SAM missiles against drones, increased missile lead speed, enabled destruction of drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and introduced a tunable drone detonation distance.
- Doubled duration for several pies and raised hunters pie bleed reduction to 90%.
- Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, boat planner tech tree cost lowered, longsword swing radius and delay adjusted for faster, more accurate attacks, swamp tree wood harvest amount increased from 300 to 1000, and tax collectors now have a tiered upkeep modifier based on player count.

### Cosmetics
- Random skin crafting now includes the default skin in the random pool.
